title: Glim
description: Word-based magic, a sinister mystery, and a deep blue sky.
body:
# ⚠️ Warning

This mod is an early work in progress! Most of its features are either not implemented or are not documented. It is currently suitable for demo in [Mod Garden: DIY](https://modgarden.net/events/mod-garden/diy). It is not recommended to use this mod in modpacks as it may spontaneously break.

# Glim

"Any sufficiently understood magic is indistinguishable from technology."
 \- Unknown

[![Mod Garden: DIY](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ModGardenEvent/art/0c0f5b5e0d21f53ad4f4667a73db4d8802944e1f/badge/svg/diy/cozy.svg)](https://modgarden.net/events/mod-garden/diy)

Somewhere, deep in a dark forest, you come upon an abnormality. Shimmering,
the cerulean **s**pheroid spea**k**s in a language unlike an**y** you've heard before.
Yet, through its frantic quivering, you feel the need to follow this creature.
Scribbled onto a wooden tablet, the sprite shows you its words beside crude depictions
of direction and ontology.

<details>
  <summary>Features</summary>

  * A word-based magic system based on a constructed language.
  * A dimension (work in progress).
  * Lore (work in progress)
  * Perception, a mana-like system used in real-world spells.

</details>
